text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Greeeeat!!
Did you see the stands? The crowd was so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So many people cheered for me on the way here.
A lot of folks are counting on me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely, positively cannot lose this!
My heart is blazing, so exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat Suzuka, come in first place,
and claim back-to-back Sprint GⅠ victories, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer-san?
Are you nervous, desu ka?"
choice_data_list: Even so, that's a bit much...
Even so, that's a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Que sera, sera, isn't it?
Whatever will be, will be, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Non... I'll become whatever I wish to be, yes I will!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And so—meet me at the finish line!
Wait for me there, Trainer!
